title: ArmorPiece
description: Technology-neutral definition of an armor piece in GUMFALL. Armor is body-region specific and tracks per-region integrity. Armor stats are not simplified to a single defense value — coverage, guard, damping, ward, mass, and articulation are all discrete fields.

slot.description: VERIFIED armor slots. Lineage-specific slots vary by lineage anatomy.

category.description: VERIFIED armor category. Determines mobility and protection tradeoffs.

material.description: Primary material. Must be consistent with level_band and VERIFIED material band table.

level_band.description: Appropriate level range for this armor piece.

coverage.description: Percentage of the body region that this piece covers (0.0–1.0). Determines how often incoming attacks interact with armor vs. bare structure.

cut_guard.description: Reduction to Slice damage type applied when coverage is hit.

pierce_guard.description: Reduction to Pierce damage type applied when coverage is hit.

crush_damping.description: Reduction to Crush damage type applied when coverage is hit.

elemental_ward.description: Elemental ward values per damage type. Each key is a damage type; value is the ward strength.

stability.description: Contribution to the Stability derived stat while this piece is worn. Affects knockback and stagger resistance.

mass.description: Physical mass in abstract units. Contributes to total encumbrance.

articulation.description: Mobility allowance (0.0–1.0). Higher articulation means less movement penalty for the equipped slot.

wards.description: Active ward effects attached to this armor piece.

ward_strength.description: Ward Strength used in the Overmatch formula: Overmatch = Enchantment Pressure − Ward Strength.

condition.description: Current physical condition of the armor piece.

provenance.description: Origin story supporting Core Pillar 8 (source-grounded loot).
examples: Crafted by Caravan smiths of the Wrapper Quarter

notes.description: Internal design notes, authority labels, or open questions.
